settings.name: USE_ANTIDDOS
settings.description: Enable or disable anti DDoS protection to mitigate high traffic spikes.

settings.name: ANTIDDOS_METRICS_DICT_SIZE
settings.description: Size of in-memory storage for DDoS metrics (e.g., 10M, 500k).

settings.name: ANTIDDOS_THRESHOLD
settings.description: Maximum suspicious requests allowed from a single IP before blocking.

settings.name: ANTIDDOS_WINDOW_TIME
settings.description: Time window (seconds) to detect abnormal request patterns.

settings.name: ANTIDDOS_STATUS_CODES
settings.description: HTTP status codes treated as suspicious for DDoS analysis.

settings.name: ANTIDDOS_DISTINCT_IP
settings.description: Minimum distinct IP count before enabling anti DDoS measures.
